title: Possession queue
instructions:
One question per frame: who has the ball? The ball is the orange box.
The loupe shows the most likely holder (the model's guess, else the player nearest the ball). Space: yes, that player holds or dribbles the ball (frame done, next). Tab: the next player, nearest the ball first. Or click the player on the frame.
N: nobody has it (a pass or shot in the air, a loose ball) · S: can't tell, skip · [ ] previous / next frame · scroll to zoom, F fit · U undo.
The holder has no box: ⇧-drag a box around him, then Enter. A shooter with the ball still in his hands counts as the holder.
